sentences: Cut formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) lung tissues into 4-µm-thick sections for immunofluorescence staining.
Boil the lung tissue sections in 10-mM sodium carbonate buffer for 20 minutes for antigen retrieval.
Permeabilize the lung tissue sections in PBS with 0.5% Triton X-100.
Incubate the lung tissue sections with blocking buffer for 1 hour at room temperature.
Stain the lung tissue sections in blocking buffer with rabbit anti-human antibodies against citrullinated histone H3 and goat anti-human antibodies against MPO for 1 hour at room temperature.

Incubate the lung tissue sections with secondary donkey anti-rabbit IgG antibodies conjugated with Alexa Fluor 568, secondary donkey anti-goat IgG antibodies conjugated with Alexa Fluor 488, and DAPI in blocking buffer for 2 hours in the dark at room temperature.
Mount the lung tissue sections with 10 µl of ProLong Antifade reagent on glass slides and store at room temperature in the dark overnight.
Analyze the mounted lung tissue sections by fluorescence microscopy using standard filter sets.
Acquire images of the stained lung tissue sections on a Zeiss LSM 880 Airyscan Elyra S.1. confocal microscope.
Perform a three-dimensional reconstruction of structures staining double positive for Cit-H3 and MPO using Imaris software.
Quantify the volume of the reconstructed 3D structures expressing Cit-H3 and MPO using Imaris software.
Scan the entire lung sections using the Nanozoomer 2.0-HT system.
Manually screen the scanned lung sections for areas rich in structures staining double positive for Cit-H3 and MPO.

sentences: Pipette 2x10^6 enriched A-CD8+ T cells into each well of a 24-well plate.
Pipette 1x10^6 B-APCs into each well containing A-CD8+ T cells.
Add IL-2 to each well to a final concentration of 20 U/ml.
Add IL-7 to each well to a final concentration of 50 ng/ml.
Add IL-15 to each well to a final concentration of 50 ng/ml.
Incubate the 24-well plate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 9 days.
After incubation, enrich the in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells from the culture.
Label A-CD4+ T cells with CFSE according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Pipette 5x10^4 CFSE-labeled A-CD4+ T cells into each well of a 96-well round bottom plate.
Pipette 5x10^4 B-APCs into the wells containing CFSE-labeled A-CD4+ T cells.
Pipette 5x10^4 I-APCs into separate wells containing CFSE-labeled A-CD4+ T cells.
Pipette 2.5x10^4 in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28- T cells into the appropriate wells as per experimental design.
Incubate the 96-well round bottom plate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 7 days.
Continue incubating the 96-well round bottom plate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for an additional 4 days.
Perform the CFSE dilution assay to assess the proliferation of CD4+ T cells after the 7-day and 11-day coculture periods.

sentences: Seed Cor3–1 cells at a density of 1.5e6 in a 10 cm dish.
Seed P19 cells at a density of 1.0e6 in a 10 cm dish.
Wash the cells with 1 ml of PBS at room temperature.
Scrape the cells in 1 ml of PBS.
Centrifuge the cells at 1200 rpm, 4°C for 3 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 5 volumes of ice-cold E1 buffer containing 1x protease inhibitors.
Pipette the suspension gently 5 times.
Centrifuge the suspension at 3400 rpm, 4°C for 2 min.
Collect the cytoplasm supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in the same volume of E1 buffer as previously used.
Centrifuge the suspension at 3400 rpm, 4°C for 2 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in the same volume of ice-cold E2 buffer containing 1x protease inhibitors as the E1 volume.
Centrifuge the suspension at 3400 rpm, 4°C for 2 min.
Collect the nucleus supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in the same volume of ice-cold E3 buffer containing 1x protease inhibitors as the E1 volume.
Sonicate the suspension using the Bioruptor device at setting H for 5 min with 30 sec ON/30 sec OFF cycles.
Centrifuge the suspension at 13000 rpm, 4°C for 10 min.
Collect the chromatin supernatant.
Determine the protein concentration using the BCA protein assay kit.

sentences: Sacrifice the DSS-treated C57BL/6 mice by CO2 euthanasia after 7 days of treatment.
Collect a small piece of proximal colon weighing 50 mg from the sacrificed mice using a scalpel and forceps for RNA extraction.
Isolate total RNA from the collected colonic tissues using TRIzol reagent according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Incubate the RNA with 0.1 volume of 8 M LiCl diluted in RNase-free water at 0°C for 2 hours.
Centrifuge the RNA-LiCl mixture at 14,000 g for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Pour out the supernatant from the centrifuged RNA-LiCl mixture.
Dissolve the RNA pellet in 200 μl of RNase-free water.
Repeat the incubation with 0.1 volume of 8 M LiCl, centrifugation, and pellet dissolution steps once more at 0°C for 2 hours.
Precipitate the RNA at -20°C for 30 minutes in 0.1 volume of 3 M sodium acetate and 2 volumes of 100% absolute ethanol.
Centrifuge the RNA-ethanol mixture at 14,000 g for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Wash the RNA pellet with 100 μl of 70% ethanol.
Centrifuge the washed RNA pellet at 14,000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged RNA-ethanol mixture.
Dissolve the RNA pellet in 20–50 μl of RNase-free water.
Assess the integrity of the purified RNA using 2% agarose gel electrophoresis.

sentences: Split confluent plates of 293T cells at a 1:4 ratio the day before transfection.
Transfect each plate of 293T cells with 1 μg gag/pol construct, 1.5 μg enhanced GFP reporter construct, and 1.5 μg envelope-expressing construct using Fugene-6 transfection reagent.

Collect the supernatant from transfected 293T cells at 72 hours post-transfection.

Store the filtered supernatant at –80°C immediately after filtering.

Incubate the serum-virion mixture at 37°C for 1 hour after mixing.
Add 100 μL of each dilution of the serum-virion mixture to QT6/ACE2 cells seeded at 1 × 10^4 cells per well in 96-well plates after 1 hour incubation.

sentences: Sow Phaseolus vulgaris seeds in vermiculite.
Set growth conditions to 23°C, 16 hours light and 8 hours dark cycle, and 75% relative humidity.
Cultivate seedlings in plastic pots containing moist vermiculite for 10 to 12 days.
Transplant three seedlings into a 20 cm plastic pot filled with moist vermiculite.
Place the seedlings in a dark room for 24 hours.
Prepare a 20 μL DNA plasmid mix containing BPMV RNA1 plasmid and BPMV RNA2 plasmid in 50 mM potassium phosphate buffer at pH 7.0.
Perform mechanical rubbing inoculation of one primary leaf using the DNA-plasmid mix.
Set post-inoculation conditions to 19°C with a 16 hours light and 8 hours dark cycle.

Maintain P. berghei strain ANKA parasites in C57BL/6 mice.
Perform cardiac puncture on the infected mouse at day 5 of infection.
Collect blood by cardiac puncture sufficient to obtain 10^6 infected erythrocytes.
Introduce 10^6 infected erythrocytes in 100 μl Alsever’s solution into a new mouse by intraperitoneal injection.
Monitor survival and signs of cerebral malaria daily from days 1 through 5.
Monitor survival and signs of cerebral malaria twice daily from days 6 through 12.
Monitor parasitaemia daily using Giemsa-stained thin film blood smears.
